## Partial result and unresolved original target

Add the proof-only reconstructed turn-3 partial for 2882 / KP 4.6. The original problem remains **UNSOLVED, 3/5**; this edition adds no substantive proof-search turn and changes no queue row.

## Accepted mathematical scope

For Y = mP # k(-O), m ≥ 1 and k > 8m, with the plumbing orientations specified in REPORT.md, every smooth oriented filling of either orientation has both positive and negative index. There is no first-Betti-number or fundamental-group hypothesis. The explicit example P # 9(-O) has boundary first homology (Z/2)^9 and a filling with form -E8 direct sum 9E7.

These are integral L-spaces. Every compatible closure of every filling and cap along such a Y has zero ordinary integral Ozsváth–Szabó invariant in each individual Spin-c structure, with all ordinary insertions. The full integral relative mixed map of a connected-sum transplant by a positive-index closed donor is zero. Every capped transplant has zero ordinary Seiberg–Witten invariant in each individual Spin-c structure and with all ordinary insertions, without a b1 restriction. The latter SW assertion is confined to capped transplants.

The original target is an absolute exotic pair of compact connected orientable smooth fillings for every prescribed closed orientable 3-manifold, which may be disconnected, as the entire boundary. Equal zero detectors provide no such pair, no proof that candidates are diffeomorphic, and no obstruction to the existence of exotic fillings. Refined, twisted, stable and families detectors are not excluded.

## Audit and editorial treatment

The fresh independent AI mathematical/source audit is retained in full mathematical detail. It accepted the reconstructed input without a mathematical correction or scope narrowing. The original audited input and later editorial bytes are separately identified; no historical byte-identical recovery or transfer of an old missing-file acceptance is claimed.

- REPORT.md updates pending-review language and supplies a chain-determinant/Schur-complement derivation of the already stated E7/E8 arithmetic, replacing dependence on an accompanying arithmetic file.
- AUDIT.md preserves all mathematical review sections 1–8 verbatim. Its introduction and concluding reproducibility section distinguish original input acceptance and historical supplementary calculations from this edition.
- VERIFICATION.md retains the entire claim-check table and source caveats; updates the audit state; replaces executable replay instructions with the historical supplementary-check record.
- SOURCE_MANIFEST.json retains every source and inspection field, updating only edition-level status/provenance. INSPECTION_MANIFEST.json is byte-identical to the independent audit's source-inspection record.

These are authored proof/audit documents and public bibliography/retrieval/inspection metadata only. The primary source foundations remain credited in the complete report. No novelty, conventional human peer review, formal proof-assistant certification or literature-wide current-open-status claim is made. Historical source inspections are not presented as newly repeated at publication.

## Exact scope and integrity

Exactly ten additive files under `unsolved_math_prioritization/attempts/2882/`. No existing file, queue, unrelated content, executable program, fixture, standalone computation result/log, copied third-party source document/text/image, dataset content, private source or private coordination material is included. The noncircular manifest hashes the other nine members. Local clean additive patch replay establishes exact byte reproduction, not mathematical truth.
